reason: Same weights as 0.5.0. Two changes only: (1) the fp32 gate is now a seeded sweep (E-021), so this is the first release since 0.3.0 built with verification ON, no --no-verify; (2) NOTICE deduplicates the FLEURS attribution, which appeared twice (one line per language entry in the source registry).
build: uv run python stt/export.py --out release --checkpoint runs/E-017/checkpoints/ckpt_best.pt --vocab release/vocab.json --head-blocks 2 --version 0.5.1
identical_to_0_5_0: all five file sha256 are unchanged; only NOTICE and config.json differ

fp32_verification.gate: seeded sweep, 20 draws per length: median <= 1e-3, worst <= 1e-2 (E-021)
fp32_verification.note: verified, not --no-verify; the old single-draw gate would have failed this export

browser.suite: web/ Playwright, Chromium headless, WASM SIMD, VAD in the loop
browser.note: in line with 0.5.0 (52.2/50.8/46.3 and 25.5/24.3/21.8); the weights are byte-identical so any difference is measurement noise
